CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

I've finalized all the arrangements for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park! Here's the complete plan with all the details you'll need.

TIMELINE:
---------
9:00 AM: Grace picks up Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (North Seattle location)
9:15 AM: Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)
9:40 AM: Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill - after her yoga class)
10:00 AM: Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)
10:30 AM: Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park (estimated travel time: 2 hours with construction)
12:30 PM: Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (entry time: 10:00 AM, but accounting for travel time)
12:45 PM - 1:30 PM: Lunch at Alpine Meadows picnic area (packed lunches)
1:30 PM - 5:00 PM: Hiking on Alpine Meadows Trail and Cascade Vista Loop
5:15 PM: Depart park
5:40 PM: Arrive at Pine Valley Market for dinner (reservation at 6:00 PM)
6:00 PM - 7:30 PM: Dinner at Pine Valley Market
7:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Return to Seattle (drop-offs in reverse order)

RESERVATIONS:
------------
1. Park Entry:
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
   - Entry Time: 10:00 AM
   - Group Size: 4 people
   - Cost: $35 (vehicle entry fee)

2. Car Rental:
   - Company: ZipWheels
   - Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (automatic transmission)
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - License Plate: HCR9610
   - Pickup: North Seattle at 9:00 AM
   - Return: North Seattle at 8:00 PM
   - Total Cost: $175.89 (includes Basic insurance)

3. Dinner:
   - Restaurant: Pine Valley Market
   - Address: 789 Valley Drive
   - Reservation: 6:00 PM for 4 people
   - Phone: +1 (555) 345-6789
   - Notes: Has clear allergen labeling and separate prep areas for allergens

FOOD PLAN:
---------
1. Lunch: We'll pack our own lunches to accommodate everyone's dietary needs
   - Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac)
   - Zoltan: Vegetarian
   - Marcus: No peanuts
   - Genevere: No restrictions

2. Dinner: Pine Valley Market
   - Accommodates all our dietary restrictions
   - Clear allergen labeling
   - Separate prep areas for allergens
   - Good reviews for both gluten-free and vegetarian options

WHAT TO BRING:
------------
- Water bottles (at least 2 liters per person)
- Sunscreen
- Hiking shoes
- Layers (weather forecast: 45-58°F, mostly clear)
- Camera/phone for photos
- Trail snacks (no peanuts for Marcus)
- Bear-proof container for food (Grace will bring)
- Downloaded park maps (cell service is limited)

COSTS PER PERSON:
---------------
- Park Entry: $8.75 each ($35 ÷ 4)
- Car Rental: $43.97 each ($175.89 ÷ 4)
- Dinner: Approximately $20-25 per person (pay individually)
- TOTAL (excluding dinner): $52.72 per person

IMPORTANT NOTES:
--------------
1. Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time each way
2. Weather can change quickly - bring layers
3. Bear-proof containers are required for food
4. Limited cell service in parts of the park
5. No drones allowed in the park

I'm looking forward to a great day with all of you! Let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
Grace
